The failing spec is bandwidth (158 MHz against a 260 MHz target). The strongest anomaly in the operating points is M5, the tail device. It sits in triode (Vds = 0.226 V, Vdsat = 0.546 V) and carries 26.7 µA. Its mirror ratio to the reference M6 (W/L 2.02/0.49 ≈ 4.1) implies about 41 µA if it were saturated, so it is oversized for the bias it receives. M6 and M7 are listed as sensitive, but they do not explain the triode condition, which points to the tail device.

```json
{"ranking": ["M5", "M6", "M7"], "fault": "M5 (tail current source) is oversized: W=2.02 um gives a mirror ratio of about 4.1 to the reference M6 (W=0.49 um). It demands more current than the bias can supply, so it is pushed into triode (Vds=0.226 V < Vdsat=0.546 V). The tail current collapses to about 26.7 uA, which lowers the input-pair bias and degrades the bandwidth. Fix: reduce M5 W so that it is saturated at the intended tail current, and keep Vds above Vdsat."}
```
